linux.cause: High-numbered inherited status descriptors leaked through Node/Linux stdio inherit into socat and wrapper/target processes. Both frames arrived but EOF did not; long-lived cancellation probe reached its hard timeout.
linux.diagnostic_tool_output_observation: Captured diagnostic tool output showed both valid frames buffered with eof=false. Pipe inode 5067327 was held by Python PID 2526 fd 19 (read flags 02004000), socat PID 2550 fd 20, sh PID 2558 fd 20, bash PID 2561 fd 20 and inner helpers (write flags 01). This is a summary of tool output; the default JUnit report did not retain captured stdout.
linux.fix: Before SRT helper/proxy spawning, reopen the inherited pipe via Node/libuv fs with CLOEXEC, then close the inherited descriptor. High-FD regression scans descriptors 3-1023 for pipe dev/inode aliases.

macos.finding: Earlier full runs encountered unknown process ownership in live preflight. Preserve failures and owned roots; later PID absence is not retrospective cleanup proof.
macos.test_bug_fixed: The new cancellation test originally waited for stdout in output-free list_processes snapshots. It now reads output explicitly and settles its task in finally.
macos.high_fd_fixture_fix: macOS soft RLIMIT_NOFILE=256 rejects F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC minimum 256. Use 128 on Darwin and retain 256 on Linux; failed fixture preparation releases its launch resources.

findings.outer_restricted_units: 11 worker transport cases failed when enclosing sandbox prohibited sysctl process inventory; 26 passed. The equivalent unrestricted unit recheck passed 44 cases.
findings.format_baseline: builtins.py already fails ruff format --check at HEAD; only two metadata fields changed and existing formatting was not rewritten. Other modified Python files pass format checks; targeted lint and node --check pass.
